coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your R&D Finance team has to keep budgets and forecasts credible for engineering and product leaders who are making big investment calls, and a forecast only helps them if they can trust it. At Calder Industrial Components, the forecast for our larger business unit was only 88% accurate, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and brought it to 96%.

As a Financial Analyst, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. I also cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA. That work gave me advanced Excel, financial modeling habits and experience managing complex data. I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers, so I'm used to turning raw numbers into something a non-finance leader can act on. I haven't worked with Pigment yet, but I'm comfortable picking up new BI tools, and I'm working towards my ACCA qualification (9 of 13 papers passed). Supporting the annual budget, quarterly Board materials and departmental budget reviews would build directly on what I do now.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could support your R&D Finance team and the Senior Manager it reports to. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt

applicationEmail.subject: Application: FP&A Analyst, Tomas Brandt
applicationEmail.body:
Hello,

Your FP&A team needs someone to manage forecasts and budgets with business leaders, and I do that today: I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD at Calder Industrial Components. I rebuilt the forecast model around order backlog, and I work daily in advanced Excel and Power BI. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm free for a call any weekday afternoon (Central Time) and can start a conversation whenever suits your team.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
